steps.title: Welcome to the Red Team Simulator
steps.content: This training preview plays a fixed, scripted sequence. It does not contact a network, change systems, or run an automated adversary.

steps.title: Vulnerability Chaining
steps.content: Review an illustrative attack path that explains how weaknesses can combine. The events and target details are sample content, not scan findings.

steps.title: Lateral Movement & Pivot
steps.content: The scripted timeline includes an example lateral-movement step. No credentials are collected, no privileges change, and no systems are accessed.

steps.title: Explore the Arsenal
steps.content: The Arsenal page is a static reference list. Its tools are not launched or connected to this training preview.

steps.title: Defense Validation
steps.content: Read and export sample Attack Paths. They are not generated by a live engagement and do not validate SIEM or EDR configurations.
